- Automatic: autoStart rising starts, first valve A. Then level>=50 close A open B. level>=80 close B. Based processMode false: start mixing motor; after complete stop motor open D auto ends. processMode true: open C; level>=100 close C start motor; after complete stop motor open D end.
代码 automatic. 潜在缺陷：
1. 自动模式最后 D 阀保持 (autoStep 0 does nothing; outputs? In CASE 0 no assignments. 之前 step40 同扫描设置 valveDRun := TRUE; autoStep:=0. Future scans autoStep 0 branch does nothing; outputs retain last values? In PLC, outputs variables retain previous values unless reassigned. So D remains true. 需求说 open valve D and automatic process ends. Does "ends" imply D open persists? 可能不明确。题面没有说关闭D，可能保持可以。代码注释明确保持D。
2. 自动启动后，在autoStep=0 and rtAuto.Q 设置10；然后 CASE autoStep OF? In same scan, IF sets autoStep 10 before CASE, so executes step 10. 好。

There's no statement that switching to auto stops manual outputs, but manual controls only manual mode. So outputs shouldn't remain manually commanded in auto before autoStart. 但可能代码 VAR_OUTPUT retention is normal; code does not set them to false in auto idle. 这是明确缺陷。

But for trace, we can set mixMotorComplete true before step 40 then keep true; expected maybe open D after? But if complete before mixing, expected? Hmm.
